faqs.question: A label peeled off in the product. How should I remove it?
faqs.answer:
Press the product's
LF/FF
button until the label appears on the platen and remove the label. If you can't remove the label this way, do not remove the platen from the product. Get the printer serviced.
Note:
We recommend you use the pull tractor to print labels. Labels fed through the rear push tractor can curl and peel off under the platen.

faqs.question: Does the product have built-in landscape fonts?
faqs.answer: No. However, your software may support them.

faqs.question: Which printers can the product emulate?
faqs.answer: The product can emulate an IBM printer.

faqs.question: Can I use the knob on the side of the product to adjust the paper position or to a clear paper jam?
faqs.answer:
Never use or turn the knob to adjust the paper position when the product is on, as this may damage the product. Instead, use the
Load/Eject
or
LF/FF
buttons to adjust the paper position.
You can turn the knob when the product is off, but doing so may cause the product to lose its top-of-form position.

faqs.question: How do I reset the product?
faqs.answer:
To reset the product's EEPROM, hold down the
Load/Eject
,
LF/FF
, and
Pause
buttons while turning on the product. The product beeps once and restores its factory default settings.

faqs.question: Can I lock the product's control panel buttons?

faqs.question: How do I select bar codes on the product?
faqs.answer:
Send the Epson ESC/P control code for the bar code to your product. The codes can only be sent through software. The following bar codes are supported:
Code 39
Code 128
EAN-8
EAN-13
Interleaved 2 of 5
POSTNET
UPC-A
UPC-E
